short: Silent NATO code-word spelling (M04), closed-lexicon beam search (M07) and a hand-squeeze stop (M09) are standard; one participant, and >9,000 words only offline.
position: The paper changes the letter-selection action (M04, silently attempted NATO code words), the language assistance (M07, letter beam search over a 1,152-word lexicon with trigram and DistilGPT-2 scoring) and the stop command (M09, attempted hand squeeze) [@metzger2022spelling]. All three are standard: spelling at the target's time used evoked potentials or motor and cursor selection (191 each of 252 studies, pattern match), and silently mouthed NATO-word sequences had been decoded from sEMG with a grammar [@meltzner2018semg]. The claim holds for one participant: 29.41 characters per minute at 6.13% median character error rate, about a third of the 90 characters per minute of attempted handwriting in 2021 [@willett2021handwriting] with a different implant. The 9,170-word result is an offline replay, and 6 of 39 conversational trials failed on out-of-vocabulary words and were excluded.
